sentences.en: Please tell me the requirements for admission to the college.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我申请大学需要哪些条件。

sentences.en: The entry requirements for the essay competition are very strict.
sentences.zh: 作文竞赛的参赛要求非常严格。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure if we can meet your requirements.
sentences.zh: 我不是很确定我们能否满足你的需求。
